name: starbucks_lookup_drink_calories
intent: Look up the calories in a Grande drink in the Starbucks app
description: Searches for a drink in the Starbucks app, opens its product details with the Grande size selected, and returns the displayed calorie count.
patterns: how many calories are in a drink
what is the calorie count for a drink
check the calories in a menu drink

inputs.name: drink_name
inputs.description: The drink to look up in the menu search

steps.intent: Tap Order to open the menu
Tap No, thanks to dismiss the location prompt
Tap Skip to skip store selection
Tap Yes to confirm skipping to the menu
Tap Search Menu to open menu search
Type {{drink_name}} into the Search Menu field
Tap the {{drink_name}} search result to open its product details
